Text: A travelling merchant requests a private audience

“My clients have rarefied tastes, which necessitate extortionate import dues.” He draws a pouch from his cloak. “If you waived those fees, I’d be so grateful.” You hear a footstep, and glimpse {Character} in the shadows. How much has {he(Character)} seen?
Consider them waived
"A pleasure doing business," the merchant beams
{Character} learns to accept fiscal opportunities - even questionable ones
Security, arrest this man! I'll not tolerate bribery and smuggling
The merchant is dragged away, crying "Sire, I did nothing wrong!"

"Is that true?" {Character} asks.

"Such men believe so," you scowl.
Sir, we appreciate your business. As a friend, you’ll pay half dues at no charge
"A pleasure doing business," the merchant beams
{Character} learns to welcome unexpected connections
{Character} asks to see you in the prison section

You heave open the section hatch. {Character} cackles behind a control desk, pressing buttons. A helpless figure jerks on the monitor.

“You got my message!” {he(Character)} beams. “Look, he’s talking! They thought he was a common criminal, but he knows something important!”
Proceed, torturer!
{Character} breaks the prisoner {himself(Character)}
"Well done!" you cry, clapping {him(Character)} on the back.
Leave: this is not children’s work - but leave the console on
You turn the electroshock dial like a maestro
Glancing back, you catch {Character} peeking through the door. "Get out of here!" you bark.
{firstName(Character)}, this is wrong! We shouldn't inflict suffering
"I'm sorry," {Character} cries, "I didn't know!"
"Nobody deserves to be treated like that," you frown, disabling the ancient interface.
During a routine shuttle patrol with {Character}, your squadron is ambushed by pirates

Laughter crackles from the radio: “Caught the {title(PlayerCharacter)}, have we? Well, I'm sure you'll burn like anyone else.”

“What do we do?” {Character} cries.
We’re getting out of here: better to fight another day!
You gun the engines
"Discretion is the better part of valour," you explain.
Values tactical retreat
{Character} believes it's sometimes better to flee, and fight another day.
Values tactical retreat
How dare they taunt me! Taste my fury, ill-bred witch-sons!
You arm the weapons array and squeeze the trigger

When the firefight - and your furious cries - are over, {Character} stares, open-mouthed, upon a field of debris.

"Revenge is a powerful motivator," you grunt.
Defeated pirates
Squadron, cover my retreat! Protect your {title(PlayerCharacter)} at all costs!
You gun the engines

The ships move into formation. One is caught by enemy fire, and explodes.

"As a noble," you explain, "keeping ourselves safe is our highest priority."
{Diplo} has arranged a series of diplomatic gatherings over the next few months
Meetings with ambassadors, receiving envoys: the dance of state. {Character} will attend every one: it’ll be good for {his(Character)} training.
Steer {Character} through politeness, small talk, and the art of the host
{Character} listens dutifully to your advice
"I believe I understand this better, now..."
Ignore {Character}: eavesdrop and gather rumours instead
You hang back, ears open, and instruct your staff to do the same
{Character} observes you hanging back, and follows suit.
Eavesdropping socialites
During a series of diplomatic gatherings, House members have been instructed to keep their ears open.
Eavesdropping socialites
Focus on outshining all others: you must make a stunning impression
“I see: so hosting a party is a way to show you’re better than everyone around you?”

“No matter what we try,” the tutors sigh, “{he(Character)} just seems... slow.”
Sadly, some people are just stupid
{Character} continues to struggle in {his(Character)} lessons
With more tutors, and my help, maybe {he(Character)}’ll come to understand
{D_s(Character)} lessons improve

{D_s(Character)} lessons improve
With a subtle shift of approach, everything suddenly clicks for {him(Character)}.
One of {PlayerHouse}’s squadrons raided a small pirate base

They return bearing footlockers brimming with looted Viridium.

“What will you do with it?” {Character} asks.
I recognise the hard work of the entire House: I will share this with them all equally
The House beam and take their trophies
I have all the wealth I need: distribute it however you see fit

Gifted share of House loot
What a perfect windfall for me!

During a council meeting, the chamber collapses!

All is twisted steel and choking rust. Medical teams drag you from the rubble; {Character} is here, face strained with concern. 

“Who should we treat first?” the doctor shouts. {Character} looks on: helpless, or curious?
Your {title(PlayerCharacter)} is dying! Treat me, immediately!
A random council member becomes ill
{Character} watches as the medics scurry to help
Treat whoever’s most injured!
{Character} watches as the medics scurry to help
These councillors are the strength of the realm: treat these wise advisors first!

You are in the middle of a lesson with {Character} when {d(Friend)} bursts in

“The commoners want my head!” {he(Friend)} splutters. “Over some silly jape!” {He(Friend)} explains {he(Friend)} may have flung a few insults last night, after one drink too many.

“So if you don’t help {him(Friend)}”, {Character} asks, “those commoners will be really angry?”
Yes - and I stand by my people!
{Character} watches as you defend {Friend}
The crowd grumble, but disperse.
Ruler defended disgusting insults
This system's ruler defended a loud-mouthed House member who mocked commoners.
Defended disgusting insults
{firstName(Friend)}, you pick the worst times! I'm busy teaching {Character} at the moment
"Why didn't you help?" {Character} asks
"Frankly, child, it would've been tiresome. Now, onto your lessons..."
Stars damn you, {firstName(Friend)}, I want nothing to do with your mess!
"Why didn't you help?" {Character} asks
You clench your fists. "I'm furious with that idiot! If they hang {him(Friend)} from the girders it'll be what {he(Friend)} deserves."
Condemned disgusting insults
Refused to help smooth over insults with commoners
{D(Diplo)} comes to your quarters one evening

“I’ve searched the archives, and I think I could fabricate a claim on {ClaimSystem} - but it would require some ‘creative copying’. Not entirely legal.”

Suddenly, {he(Diplo)} sees {Character} watching from the shadows. “Ah! The {title(PlayerCharacter)} and I were just... ahem, discussing...”
{firstName(Diplo)} was suggesting something shameful, which I am declining. Firmly.
{Diplo} apologises awkwardly and leaves
"My mistake." {He(Diplo)} scowls at {Character}.
Rejected proposal to acquire claim on {ClaimSystem}

Your guards block {his(Friend)} entrance.

“Let me see the {title(PlayerCharacter)}, I’m desperate!" you hear. "I’ve been... unwise in my gambling lately. If our companionship means anything... I hoped those debts might be paid.”
Guard, tell {him(Friend)} I’m indisposed: I’d rather not deal with {him(Friend)}
"Why didn't you help?" {Character} asks

Refused to help pay debts
I won’t have the {man(Friend)} dipping in my private coffers!
"Why didn't you help?" {Character} asks

Refused to help pay debts
{firstName(Friend)}, take this gift: I have enough
"Why did you help {him(Friend)}?" {Character} asks
"When we have so much, we should try to be generous," you smile.
Helped pay debts
I’d never turn my back on you - but we must discuss this gambling, extensively

"Thank you," {he(Friend)} smiles. "You're a true help."

A delegation has arrived from {houseOf(ForeignRuler)}, in {ForeignSystem}
{D(Diplo)} has arranged tours and social functions. You will need to attend most of them to avoid a breach of courtesy. “You have to attend all these?” {Character} frowns.
They’ve travelled a long way: we should at least be friendly
You and {Character} meet the delegation
You clasp their hands. "{houseOf(PlayerCharacter)} looks forward to many happy meetings."
Delegation welcomed by {PlayerCharacter}
Of course not! Someone of my station does not bow and scrape like that
You and {Character} meet the delegation
"You are welcome," you begin, "but do not trespass on this {title(PlayerCharacter)}'s patience."
Oh my stars, all those people? No, I’ll remain in my quarters
You and {Character} remain in your quarters
Every time a servant asks for you, the two of you think up another excuse.
Delegation shunned by {PlayerCharacter}
You are making progress decoding an ancient storage device when {Character} bursts in
“{Host} is throwing one of {his(Host)} parties!” {he(Character)} beams. “Let’s go!”
I’d rather finish decrypting this algorithm...
The storage device contained a wealth of information
{Character} is impressed. “I suppose studies are important after all...”
Decrypted storage device
This ancient data stick contains a wealth of technical and scientific data.
Decrypted storage device
Come: before we go, let me show you how these devices work
Title
Very well, let’s arrive fashionably late - and have a fabulous night!
You enjoy a night of revelry

In the morning you pay the price: your head pounds; your whole stomach feels ready to slosh over.

What a night, though...
Drunkard

As the tourney shuttles are being prepared, you notice an opportunity

A tank of concentrated warp fuel sits in a corner of the hangar. It’s not intended for shuttle use, but would significantly improve the craft’s speed. Naturally, this would be cheating.

{Character} catches you eyeing the fuel. “What are you doing?”
Winning at any cost, child
{Character} watches as you pour the fuel into your tank
"This'll be our little secret," you whisper.
Cheating in tournament
An injection of concentrated warp fuel has given your tourney shuttle an unfair advantage.
Cheating in tournament
Warning the quartermaster to lock that stuff up: someone could cheat with it!
{Character} watches as the quartermaster removes the fuel
Giving myself a true challenge: these tourneys are so easy!
Ignoring the warp fuel, you instead sabotage your shuttle's engine
As you pilot it to the sparring area, the engine whirs angrily.
When you warm the vessel up with some light sparring, smoke sputters from the console. You just have time to request an emergency landing before the dash explodes.

Before long, though, you've adapted to the engine's quirks. 

"Bring on the tourney," you grin.
A travelling composer offers to write a zero-G ballet commemorating your rule
{Character} watches from your side as the composer relates the “brilliant deeds” he will work into the text.
Of course! Make sure I’m portrayed as wise, and fair, and brilliant, and...
The piece is a great success
{Character} applauds as the dancers take their bows.
The subject of a flattering Zero-G ballet
No: a ruler should serve his people, not commission monuments to vanity
"Why did you refuse?" {Character} asks, as the composer leaves
"I'm nothing special. I'm only great because of my people."
Actually, could you write a little jingle about the importance of hydroponic efficiency?
The jingle is catchy, effective, and despised
Perhaps he shouldn't have rhymed "hydroponics" with "electronics" and "histrionics"...
Hydroponic Jingle

Thanks to this catchy jingle, every subject knows how to keep hydroponics bays that little bit tidier.

The jingle is widely hated, but no matter.
Hydroponic Jingle

“We hereby deliver these gifts: an astronomical compass, to aid {PlayerCharacter} when they become lost (as they invariably are), and this prize poodle, whose wisdom will outshine the feeble minds of {PlayerHouse}.”

{Character} squints at the messenger. “Why does he tremble so?”
Received insult
Tell that spawn of a witch-mutant I will send {his(Insulter)} head into orbit!
You spew insults and spittle at the messenger
